hooks.command: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec python3 -I gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py pre-tool --role hardener'

Stop.command: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec python3 -I gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py stop --agent hardener --task mutationGate --max-attempts 2 --timeout 3300'
